name: Wreck Raiders

categories.label: Claimed Exhibits (coin value)
categories.labelVi: Triển lãm đã nhận (giá trị xu)
categories.hint: Sum of coin value printed on each claimed Exhibit.

categories.label: Conch decorations used on Exhibits
categories.labelVi: Ốc xà cừ dùng làm trang trí
categories.hint: 2 coins per Conch used as a decoration when claiming an Exhibit.

categories.label: Unique treasures in vault
categories.labelVi: Kho báu khác nhau trong hầm
categories.hint: 1 coin per unique treasure (by picture) in the vault, any location.

categories.label: Vault rows of one type
categories.hint: Coin value shown for each row that is full of treasures of the same type.

categories.label: Aquarium Bottoms and Middles
categories.labelVi: Bể cá: tầng đáy và tầng giữa
categories.hint: Coin value displayed on every Bottom and Middle tile of all your aquariums.

categories.label: Aquarium Tops (formula)
categories.hint: Apply each Top's pink-bubble formula to its aquarium and add the results.

categories.label: Tiebreak: leftover treasures in displays
categories.labelVi: Phá hòa: kho báu thừa trong trưng bày

categories.label: Tiebreak: leftover seashells in basket
categories.labelVi: Phá hòa: vỏ sò còn lại

tiebreakers.description: Most leftover treasures in your displays
Most leftover seashells in your basket
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: set-collection. Game ends when a player claims their 6th/5th/4th/4th Exhibit (2/3/4/5 players); every other player gets one more turn. Score track wraps at 50. Solo mode scores the same way (rival-based end triggers) and compares to a rating chart; not a separate file.
